gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a favorable prior year development of GBP 11.2 million in its claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries, for the year ended 31 December 2023. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development across direct Third Party Liability (GBP 7.0 million release), accepted reinsurance (GBP 3.6 million release), and Aviation business (GBP 0.9 million release). This was partially offset by a strengthening of GBP 0.3 million in Other direct business. The syndicate's reserving methods incorporate allowances for economic and excess inflation, and management has made explicit uplifts to net best estimate reserves to reflect the heightened inflationary environment and broader economic uncertainty, as well as loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses.
